{{nihongo|'''Sakuta Shrine'''|佐久太神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

{{wikidata link|Q11382602|ja|佐久太神社|grok=none|check_date=2026-07-06}}

Its {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former rank}} was village shrine.

=== Overview ===
The date of founding is unknown. It is said to have been called "Kumano Gongen" in the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}.
